title: Outlook AI assistant for meeting mail and follow-ups
h1: an outlook bot for the mail around your meetings
description: Use Metal with Outlook to prepare meeting context, find promised replies and review folders. See the actual actions and where approvals apply.
answer: **walk into the renewal call knowing what you already promised.** an outlook bot reads the calendar, finds related mail and hands you the last agreement, open questions and replies you owe. connect the mailbox and choose its ai. start read only for briefings. saved drafts need write access; sends ask by default unless your sending settings allow them.

review.by: lead agent: read against seo/facts, automated gate, independent fact-check pass

og_line: meeting context from the mail you have.

app.name: Outlook
app.intro: **get the email behind the calendar title.** a meeting name rarely tells you the last agreement or the reply you owe. these actions put the appointment and its mail together, then let you draft or file when the job needs it.

highlight.use: find the mail about the customer or topic on your calendar
read a matched email before using it in a briefing
see which appointments need background today
identify the folder you actually use for active projects
review messages in a named project folder
save a reply to an existing message for you to inspect (it counts as a send, so it asks first)
file a specific message into the folder you named
send a reviewed draft through the bot's sending controls

app.setup:
**tell the bot whether you mean work or personal mail.**

choose outlook in **connected apps**, sign in through microsoft and enable it for your bot. label accounts clearly when you connect more than one.

start with reading access for briefings that need no saved drafts.

routines_intro: **pick one gap in your day.** these routines read current outlook mail and events. start with background notes before allowing saved replies or folder changes.

routines.name: meeting background
routines.message: every weekday at 8:30, read today's outlook events. for meetings about hushfen, find related mail. show the last agreed point, open questions and relevant message subjects here. say when the mail cannot answer something. never move events or write to anyone.
routines.output: short background notes for today's hushfen meetings

routines.name: promises i made
routines.message: every wednesday at 4, search this week's outlook replies for promises i made to send something later. read surrounding messages before deciding a follow-up is missing. quote each possible open promise here and mark uncertainty. never send reminders or edit mail.
routines.output: possible open commitments, with the promise beside each

routines.name: project folder review
routines.message: every other friday at 10, read my outlook folder hushfen renewal. find messages that still need a reply. draft answers only where the mail supports them. ask before creating each draft reply and leave it unsent. list missing decisions here. never invent prices or move messages.
routines.output: unsent reply drafts after approval, plus missing decisions

asks:
**keep the reply ready while you decide what to say.** a new email draft stays a draft. **create draft reply** counts as a send in dusk because its name includes reply. it follows sending controls even though it saves a draft.

- sends show **Allow** and **Deny** by default
- a daily amount can allow sends without individual approval

careful with **Full access**: a bot there with no sending rule can send up to 25 a day without asking. give it **Ask every time**.

folder moves and calendar changes skip sending approval. keep a background reader read only. for supervised writes, say "ask me before you change anything".
cannot: **save outlook drafts while read only.** it can read and report in chat. a saved draft needs write access.
**read a mailbox you have not connected.** signing in elsewhere does not connect it to dusk. connect each account you want it to use.
**prepare an early brief on a sleeping computer.** local routines need dusk open and the computer awake. cloud can run the job before you wake.

sections.h: read the evidence before drafting the answer
sections.md:
**bring the missing price decision into the meeting.** if the mail only asks "can you confirm the price?", put that question in the brief. draft an answer once someone decides.

use the [meeting prep brief](/routines/meeting-prep-brief) to turn open questions into an agenda you can use.

**start with one project, not your whole working life.** outlook and [gmail](/integrations/gmail) use different actions, folders and controls. do not assume every instruction maps across unchanged.

use a short date window or named folder first. if deciding which messages need you is the main pain, try [email triage](/use-cases/email-triage).

faq.q: can an outlook ai assistant read my calendar as well as email?
faq.a: **yes, if you allow both actions.** outlook offers calendar listing and message search. name the account and project so the bot finds relevant mail.

faq.q: will it reply to customers while i am away?
faq.a: **choose ask every time for sending.** leave drafts unsent and grant no daily sending amount. the full-access setting needs its own sending rule too.

faq.q: how do i use the assistant from my phone?
faq.a: **pair your phone to the bot's host.** your computer must stay on with dusk running. pairing to dusk cloud works with your computer off.

steps: connect outlook with read only access
name one meeting on today's calendar
ask for related mail and the last agreed point
open the message behind its last-agreed point

mistakes.mistake: answering a question with a guessed price
mistakes.fix: require a supporting message or leave the price open.

mistakes.mistake: assuming every saved draft uses the same controls
mistakes.fix: outlook draft replies count as sends in dusk. set sending to ask every time.

tip.text: a useful brief can say "we still do not know". a confident guess costs more.

worked.intro: an invented example, with made-up names.
worked.before:
sophie has a renewal meeting at 10.
the latest email asks for a price confirmation.

worked.after:
